ownership: MCD owns local staging, object store, active pointer, cleanup and verified delivery receipt. The connector owns transport and authentication only.
sequence: download exact bytes into isolated staging
verify transport/auth, schema, version/revision, size, SHA-256, signature/trust and context compatibility
fsync staged bytes and atomically move the object
fsync and atomically switch the active pointer
delete only the previous local object after the receipt is emitted

receipt.cleanup_after_receipt: true means the previous object remains retained until this receipt is durably emitted/queued; a later successful drain completes cleanup.

failure.staging_or_verification: remove only the staging/partial new object and keep the previous active pointer/object
failure.activation: keep the previous active pointer/object; never execute the new artifact
failure.receipt_delivery: retain the previous object and pending cleanup state until the receipt queue drains
failure.catalog: MCC/Portal immutable catalog revisions are never deleted; rollback re-downloads a pinned old revision

idempotency: The same active revision/digest returns an idempotent verified receipt without a second activation. Concurrent deliveries are serialized by the MCD store lock.
execution_boundary: No runner is started by this contract. The generic scenario runner may execute only after activation and frame/context admission succeed.
